beats.say: Grand Theft Auto 6 took over a decade of work before reaching its scheduled release date of 19 November 2026.

lines: Over a Decade in the Making

beats.say: Preliminary work on the open world adventure quietly began all the way back in 2014 before anyone outside the studio knew.
Full production kicked off properly after Red Dead Redemption 2 launched to massive success in 2018.
Rockstar officially confirmed development was underway in February 2022 before a formal reveal followed in December 2023.
The massive project also introduces Lucia Caminos as the series first ever non optional female protagonist.
All that time means Grand Theft Auto 6 took over a decade of work.
